context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 after major combat overhaul. Key changes tested: (1) Skills start locked (0/7 Awakened), unlock through combat mastery with progress bars. (2) Skill Tree tab renamed from Skills. (3) All 7 skills show unlock conditions: Flame Dash (Dash 4 times), Wind Slash (Hit Kairen 8 times), Earth Shield (Block 2 attacks), Lightning (Land 2 full combos), Shadow Step (Perfect counter 2 attacks), Divine Wrath (Perfect counter 5 attacks), Heal (Survive 40 damage). (4) Equipment and Keybinds tabs working. (5) Backend uses GPT-5.2 for NPC AI via Emergent LLM Key. Battle mode triggered by walking to right edge of village map (x:27-29, y:5-8). Note: Battle mode testing requires manual gameplay - skills unlock during combat through actions like dashing, hitting, blocking, perfect counters.
